thread:
claire.design: Quick poll 1 trace actions: should Copy correlation id be primary? current mock has Export as the prominent CTA and Copy as a tiny icon. raj.product: My vote: copy-first. Teams paste corr ids into tickets/chat a lot. Export is rarer. claire.design: Data check? morgan.pm: Quick query: last 30d event counts: copy ~420, export ~110. Copy ~3.8x. sam.eng: From infra POV exports can trigger heavy work for big traces. If we make export secondary we should make its async nature explicit. claire.design: Proposal: visually prioritize Copy (text chip), keep Export under a dropdown with short format descriptions (JSON = full; CSV = flattened). aria.a11y: Accessibility notes: the corr id chip must be focusable, have aria-label including the id and action, and update an aria-live region on copy. Also on focus show full id to SRs. claire.design: Example SR pattern we can use: ```
``` aria.a11y: Good. Also add aria-atomic="true" on the sr-toast so screenreaders read full messages. sam.eng: We'll implement a hidden region. And backend supports async export jobs; we'll return a job id and poll. For big jobs we can immediately show "Export queued" and send email/webhook when ready. claire.design: What about keyboard shortcuts? Suggest `c` to copy corr id when the trace pane is focused. aria.a11y: Fine but ensure we surface the shortcut hint (e.g., a small helper "Press ? for shortcuts") and avoid clashes with global keys. Document in keyboard help modal. raj.product: Mobile considerations: on narrow view (<480px) collapse Export into the kebab menu to avoid crowding. Copy chip should remain visible and touch-friendly. claire.design: Agreed. I'll increase hit target to 44px for touch. morgan.pm: On analytics, please emit events: `trace.copy_corr_id`, `trace.export_initiated`, `trace.export_completed`. Keep export_initiated payload: format, trace_length, user_tier. sam.eng: Will emit those. export_completed will include file_size and optional storage_url. claire.design: UX states we need: idle, copying (show transient check icon + SR announcement), export queued (toast), export ready (download link + sr announcement). claire.design: copy SR snippet: ``` // after successful copy const srToast = document.getElementById('sr-toast'); srToast.textContent = 'Correlation ID 0000-aaaa copied to clipboard'; ``` aria.a11y: Also toggle aria-pressed or add `aria-live` change so ATs detect the interaction. Ensure color contrast of the chip text meets 4.5:1. sam.eng: We'll add 2px focus ring and ensure DOM order reflects logical action order (Copy then Export) so SRs navigate correctly. Avoid reordering for visual-only reasons. claire.design: For the Export dropdown, include helper text under each option: JSON (full raw trace), CSV (flattened spans), HAR (request timeline). raj.product: Good. For very large exports, consider offering "lite" export that strips heavy payloads to reduce wait. Not for MVP though. claire.design: Noted. I'll add to backlog. deploy-bot: snapshot uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/trace-cta-v3.png aria.a11y: Preview looks cleaner. Final checks: focus outlines visible, chip contrast, sr announcements, and make sure the copy control isn't a generic icon-only button without an accessible name. morgan.pm: Let's canary at 5% then 25% and monitor copy/export metrics + export error rates. claire.design: I'll post updated mock and a short spec with keyboard flows, SR copy examples, and the analytics event names shortly. Thanks! :sparkles:
